title: How Do You Start a Career Pivot? 🔎
description:
If you’re thinking about a career pivot what are the things to consider and keep in mind? The first is you always want to be honest. Stretching the truth on skills or your resume is only going to hurt in the long run. Number 2 is dropping “aspiring” from your LinkedIn headline. Lastly, start working in less hard skills and more transferrable skills. #careerpivot #careerpivots #careertok #careeradvice
